name: Dating An Unbeliever
overview: Scripture clearly advises believers to avoid forming marital bonds with unbelievers, emphasizing the importance of spiritual agreement in relationships, as seen in Deuteronomy 7:3 and Amos 3:3. Protecting one's heart with diligence is paramount because the condition of the heart directs the course of life, highlighting the need for careful discernment in romantic involvement with those who do not share the same faith.
